content:
Available egress settings.
This controls what traffic is diverted through the VPC Access Connector resource. By default
PRIVATE_RANGES_ONLY will be used.
Enums
VPC_CONNECTOR_EGRESS_
SETTINGS_UNSPECIFIED
Unspecified.
PRIVATE_RANGES_ONLY
Use the VPC Access Connector only for private IP space from RFC1918.
ALL_TRAFFIC
Force the use of VPC Access Connector for all egress traffic from the function.
